name: 2x Avalanche ETF
desc: Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the value of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in AVAX-Linked Instruments. AVAX is a digital commodity that is created and transmitted through the operations of the peer-to-peer Avalanche Network, a dispersed network of computers that operates on cryptographic protocols based on open-source code. It is non-diversified.
